name: Pixel Interface
description: Square pixel corners, a 4px ink border inside a 2px ink ring whose corner pixels are notched out, a two-step drop to the right in the strong border color, each step 2px, the outer one cut in a pixel at top and bottom, so a stacked frame keeps page ground between it and the next, ink outlines, dashed pixel rules, compact density, stepped motion, and a dither texture on the shared surfaces.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.derivation: The reviewed prototype's pixel recipe, with its --appearance-* references read as --color-*, and the contract's signature-fill and emphasis-glow at the fallback language's values.

fallbacks: Under reduced transparency, without backdrop-filter, in forced colors, and in print, surfaces render opaque and the backdrop blur is 0.
Under reduced motion, transforms and emphasis stop and entrances and exits fade; a paused boundary and print are instant.
In forced colors, the material is a solid surface, and shadows and texture drop.
caveats: A decorative gradient texture sits behind surfaces.
Expressive state motion: hovers and presses move more than in a quiet language.
Its enter motion, pixel-in, and exit motion, pixel-out, and emphasis motion, blink-once, have no keyframes in the platform yet, so they don't animate.
